goal_claim_rule: NEVER CLAIMABLE: this Goal is a planning container only. Builders claim one contained sub-goal.

boundary_rules: Developer Platform owns generic extension contracts, SDK/scaffolding, isolation/compatibility, authority declarations, generative-UI extension conformance, package assembly and developer documentation.
Skills, manifests, SDKs, templates, code generators, test harnesses, UI component schemas and package registries are tools/capabilities/state, not workforce identities.
Goal 28 Integration Ecosystem retains connector-specific certification/runtime/publication ownership; Goal 29 reuses its connector certification/publication seams rather than cloning them.

Titan Forge remains governed generation infrastructure; Titan Builder remains build tooling; Titan MCP remains a tool/integration surface. None is reclassified as a workforce identity merely because Goal 29 uses it.
Governance/Risk/Assurance retain authority decisions; Developer Platform declares and validates extension authority requirements but cannot self-approve expanded authority.
Extensibility Evolution Orchestrator coordinates platform evolution but does not replace Titan Prime strategic orchestration or accountable business/platform Managers.

agent_goal_rule: This goal owns durable business/domain outcomes and may reuse, extend or create canonical workforce identities subject to non-duplication and outcome-owner tests.
workforce_goal_rule: Agents are permitted only for durable business/operational outcomes with a distinct ownership boundary. Reuse or extend canonical identities before creating new ones.
